blocks.text: The Manila-Washington trade deal was reached during U.S. President Trump’s brief state visit to the Philippines. Details of this agreement have yet to be revealed, even as Philippine President Marcos Jr. said no discussions were held on the controversial U.S.-led Pax Silica Initiative.
